why_Shubin: IRI-2016 irisub.for 'standard version' column: jf(39)=false, jf(40)=false -> hmF2 Shubin-COSMIC; iricore.get_jf('default') sets exactly the standard set (plus messages off). The form's DEFAULT is AMTB-model, which is NOT the IRI-2016 standard and must be changed on the form.
